items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Pierce was supposed to be my manager, I thought he would let me... Mr. Pierce kept all the mail that was mailed to me.

ctx.x: My goodness. Was that Mr. Pierce still your agent then, at that time?

No, after -- see, around then, Mr. told me that Mr. Pierce wasn't up there no more. But he carried me over -- I got this contract from the Victor people, but my brother wouldn't let me (unintelligible).
Well, at that time, that was 1929, you were very popular then.
